SAEximDebug.description: Enable basic verbose output by default.

SAEximRunCond.description: Exim configuration string to run before running SA against the message. This decides whether SA gets run against the message or not.

SAEximRunCondOverride.description: Override value for SAEximRunCond to enable/disable sa-exim. Remove or comment out the previous line to enable.

SAmaxbody.description: How much of the body we feed to spamassassin (in bytes). Default is 250KB.

SATruncBodyCond.description: Do you want to feed SAmaxbody's worth of the message body if it is too big? 0: do not scan messages that are too big.

SARewriteBody.description: If you want SA to report_safe you need sa-exim to rewrite the body of the message since SA encapsulates the spam as a mime attachment.

SAPrependArchiveWithFrom.description: Prepend saved messages with an fake From-header to make the file look like a valid mbox file.

SAmaxarchivebody.description: If you are archiving messages that are rejected, how much do you want to archive? Default is 20MB.

SAerrmaxarchivebody.description: On errors, if you are saving messages, you probably want the entire message. Default size saved (if you are saving errors) is 1GB.

SAmaxrcptlistlength.description: Limit for X-SA-Exim-Rcpt-To header length. Default 0 disables it for privacy reasons.

SAaddSAEheaderBeforeSA.description: Add X-SA-Exim-Rcpt-To and X-SA-Exim-Mail-From headers before SA scans the message.

SAtimeoutsave.description: Directory to save mails that were accepted because spamc timed out.

SAtimeoutSavCond.description: Condition to optionally save or not save messages that matched the timeout rule.

SAerrorsave.description: Directory for local_scan to save messages that created an error.

SAerrorSavCond.description: Condition to optionally save or not save messages that matched the error rule.

SAtemprejectonerror.description: If set to 1, SA will temporarily reject messages that generated an error while they were processed. Otherwise, messages are just accepted.

SAteergrubetime.description: How long do you want to stall the sender (in seconds).

SAteergrubeSavCond.description: Condition to optionally save or not save messages that matched the teergrube rule.

SAteergrubesave.description: Directory to save mails that you stalled for later analysis.

SAteergrubeoverwrite.description: When you stall the sender, by default we'll only save messages by message ID so that we don't save multiple copies every time the sender tries again.

SAdevnullSavCond.description: Condition to optionally save or not save messages that matched the devnull rule.

SAdevnullsave.description: Directory to save mails that are tossed (devnull).

SApermreject.description: SA score when you start rejecting Emails. This is better than the above as it can notify the sender in case you reject non-spam by mistake.

SApermrejectSavCond.description: Condition to optionally save or not save messages that matched the permreject rule.

SApermrejectsave.description: Directory to save mails that are rejected.

SAtemprejectSavCond.description: Condition to optionally save or not save messages that matched the tempreject rule.

SAtemprejectsave.description: Directory to save mails that are temporarily rejected.

SAtemprejectoverwrite.description: When you send back a temp reject code, by default we'll only save messages by message ID so that we don't save multiple copies every time the sender tries again.

SAgreylistiswhitestr.description: The string that SpamAssassin adds if the message is whitelisted.

SAgreylistraisetempreject.description: By how much do we temporarly raise tempreject to allow a mail in when it would otherwise have been temp rejected.

SAspamacceptsave.description: Directory to save mails that are flagged as spam by SA, but not rejected by any of the above thresholds.

SAspamacceptSavCond.description: Condition to control which messages you want saved if you only want a subset of spam accepted.

SAnotspamsave.description: Directory to save mails that are not flagged as spam by SA.

SAnotspamSavCond.description: Condition to control which messages you want saved if you only want a subset of non-spam.

SAmsgerror.default: Temporary local error while processing message, please contact postmaster.
